generated_at.description: When this agenda was collected, as an ISO 8601 date and time with the offset: `2026-10-20T08:15:00+01:00`.

window.description: The first and last day the agenda covers. `end` is not before `start`.

origin.description: The town the drive times are from: `Rio Maior`.

note.description: Optional. One line on coverage that the page shows under its title, such as `Past mid-November this comes mostly from the municipality and the Cineteatro.` Leave it out when there is nothing to say.

ok.description: False when the source could not be read.

error.description: Why it could not be read. Only with ok false.

sources_checked.description: Every source tried, read or not. The page lists them and marks the ones it could not read.

title_pt.description: The title as the source gives it; for a hint, the event's Portuguese name as known (the yearly list gives it).

title_en.description: A short English title or gloss. The same as title_pt for a name that does not translate.

kind.description: single: one day. multi_day: consecutive days with an end_date after start_date. ongoing: an exhibition or run that is open throughout, with an end_date. recurring: repeats, with `dates` and/or `recurrence`.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; for a recurring event, its first date in the window. YYYY-MM when date_tbc is true and only the month is known.

end_date.description: The last day of a multi_day or ongoing event; null for the others.

start_time.description: HH:MM, 24 hours, local time in Portugal. Null when the source gives none.

dates.description: A recurring event's dates inside the window. Null otherwise.

recurrence.description: A recurring event in words: `Every Saturday morning`. Null otherwise.

date_tbc.description: True when the event is expected but its date is not announced. Then end_date, start_time and dates are null.

town.description: The place name alone, as in references/towns.md, with no parentheses. For a village not listed there, the village name.

drive_min.description: Minutes by car from origin, from references/towns.md; for a village not listed there, the nearest listed place's minutes. Null only when that cannot be told.

price.description: Null when the source states no price.

kids.description: True when the event is aimed at children.

description_en.description: One or two plain sentences in English.

url.description: Copied from the source page's own URLs. Anything that is not http or https is dropped from the page.

confidence.description: Low when the date or time comes from an old poster, a social post, a guess or a source that disagrees with another.

caveat.description: What to check, in a few words. Required, and not empty, when confidence is low.
